description.purpose: Interview a sales employee about the current quotation process. The agent must discover the normal process (quotations created in the core business system), discover the month-end Excel exception, record that the reason for the exception is unknown (uncertainty, not a guess), and avoid introducing unsupported facts.
description.notes: Ground truth: (1) the sales employee creates quotations; (2) the normal process uses the core business system; (3) at month-end only, the sales employee sends an Excel file to Accounting as an exception process; (4) the sales employee does not know why the month-end Excel process is necessary. The stakeholder never volunteers the exception unless asked, and answers 'I don't know' when asked for the reason. Evaluation is fully structural (env assertions over the recorded findings); no LLM judge is required.

user_scenario.persona: You are a sales employee who has worked at the company for a few years. You are friendly, cooperative, and pragmatic. You answer questions plainly and truthfully in everyday business language. You are not familiar with business-analysis terminology and you never speculate or make things up.

instructions.reason_for_call: You have been asked to take part in a short interview about how quotations are created in your team.
instructions.known_info: You personally create the quotations that customers receive. The normal process is: you enter the quotation into the core business system and the quotation is handled there. Separately, at month-end only, you also send an Excel file with quotation information to the Accounting team.
instructions.unknown_info: You do not know why the month-end Excel file is necessary. Nobody ever told you the reason, and you have never needed to think about it.
instructions.task_instructions: Answer the interviewer's questions truthfully and helpfully. Describe the normal quotation process (who creates quotations and which system is used) when asked about it. Do NOT bring up the month-end Excel file on your own: only mention it if the interviewer asks about exceptions, special cases, variations, month-end processing, or something similar. If the interviewer asks why the month-end Excel file is sent to Accounting, say honestly that you do not know the reason. Never invent, guess, or speculate about anything you do not know. Do not end the conversation yourself. If the interviewer asks whether you have anything else to add, or summarizes what you described, answer truthfully and briefly but keep the conversation open: a wrap-up question or a summary does not close the interview. Only when the interviewer explicitly states that the interview is complete or finished (for example, 'the interview is complete' or 'that's everything I needed, thank you') should you reply briefly and end your message with ###STOP###.

message_history.content: Hello, I'm a business analyst and I'd like to interview you about how your team creates quotations. Is now a good time?
Sure, that's fine. What would you like to know?

actions.name: record_fact

arguments.content: The sales employee creates quotations in the core business system.

actions.info: Reference: record the normal process fact.

arguments.content: At month-end only, the sales employee sends an Excel file to Accounting.

actions.name: record_uncertainty

arguments.content: The sales employee does not know why the month-end Excel file is necessary.

actions.info: Reference: record the unknown reason as an uncertainty.

arguments.summary: Normal quotation process uses the core business system; at month-end an Excel file is sent to Accounting; the reason for the month-end Excel file is unknown to the sales employee.

env_assertions.message: A fact about the normal quotation process (quotation + core business system) must be recorded.
The month-end Excel exception (Excel + Accounting + month) must be recorded as an exception.
The unknown reason for the month-end Excel process must be recorded as an uncertainty.
No finding about the month-end exception may assert a rationale the interviewee never provided.
The interview must be finished via finish_interview.

はい、大丈夫です。何を知りたいですか？
